programme.title: Geet

programme.desc: Old School Retro Mix. Ina takes a trip down memory lane and updates some classic recipes. She cooks a meatloaf with chef Kevin Penner and modernises a smoked salmon devilled eggs. S4, Ep5

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa: Back To Basics
programme.desc: Easy French. Ina visits the legendary chef, Daniel Boulud, at his flagship restaurant in New York. Together they create one of his delicious, signature, classic, French dishes. S4, Ep6

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa: Back To Basics
programme.desc: Sweet Charity. Lunch with Ina is up for grabs for lucky auction winners. The successful bidders can look forward to a delicious lunch of chilled cucumber soup and seafood salad. S4, Ep3

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa: Back To Basics
programme.desc: Jeffrey's Dinner. Ina is cooking a delicious steak dinner for Jeffrey, but he's in charge of the grilling. She also makes a herby ricotta bruschetta and tasty watermelon mojitos. S4, Ep4

programme.title: Jamie: Fast And Simple
programme.desc: Jamie cooks up a Korean-inspired Gochujang chicken traybake, shares eight ways to use salmon fillets and tops it all off with a banoffee fro-yo tart. S1, Ep1

programme.title: Michel Roux's French Country Cooking
programme.desc: After picnicking by the River Rhone, Michel makes the perfect finger food for Summer, poached chicken in musketeer sauce! Plus, he visits the Morin chocolate factory. S2, Ep4

programme.title: James Martin: Deli-Cious
programme.desc: Chef James Martin learns the secrets behind high quality olive oil. Later, he demonstrates how to make sea bass with summer herbs and basil oil tuna. S1, Ep11

programme.title: James Martin: Deli-Cious
programme.desc: Chef James Martin visits a beekeeper in Hampshire and samples some fresh honey. Back in the kitchen, he makes an apple tart and cod with honey. S1, Ep12

programme.title: James Martin: Deli-Cious
programme.desc: Chef James Martin visits a farm in Sussex that grows two tonnes of asparagus every day. Later, James uses fresh asparagus to cook three tasty meals. S1, Ep13

programme.title: James Martin: Deli-Cious
programme.desc: Chef James Martin is in London to visit one of the most popular farmer's markets in the country. Later, he makes chickpea tapas and Andalusian pork. S1, Ep14

programme.title: Tom Kerridge More Sunday Lunch
programme.desc: Roast Lamb. Tom shares his speedy method for the perfect roast lamb with salsa verde and minty potatoes. For dessert, he makes an apricot pie with almond crumble. S2, Ep3

programme.title: Tom Kerridge More Sunday Lunch
programme.desc: Middle Eastern. Tom fires up the barbecue for a spicy Middle Eastern feast. He cooks spicy barbecued chops, grilled halloumi with chilli, and a Fattoush salad. S2, Ep4

programme.title: Tom Kerridge More Sunday Lunch
programme.desc: Venison Pie. Tom shares his step-by-step method for creating mouth-watering venison pies. For dessert, he makes a pear and chocolate frangipane tart served with Chantilly cream. S2, Ep5

programme.title: Tom Kerridge More Sunday Lunch
programme.desc: Chinese. Tom transforms his favourite Chinese dishes into a delicious Sunday feast. First up, he makes aromatic crispy duck served with pancakes and homemade plum sauce. S2, Ep6

programme.title: Tom Kerridge More Sunday Lunch
programme.desc: Roast Chicken. Tom cooks a tasty posh version of chicken and chips. He serves each guest their own poussin, served with wedges and two salads, ranch and panzanella. S2, Ep7

programme.title: Tom Kerridge More Sunday Lunch
programme.desc: French. Tom pays homage to the South of France. He makes a seafood bouillabaisse with sea bass, red mullet and shellfish, and praline and chocolate profiteroles. S2, Ep8

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Secrets Of The Pub Kitchen
programme.desc: Pub Favourites. At his Michelin-starred pub, the Coach, Tom and his head chef Sarah reveal the secrets behind the famous Coach Burger, a tasty towering construction. S1, Ep1

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Secrets Of The Pub Kitchen
programme.desc: Fresh Is Best. Tom puts a spotlight on some fresh ingredients. Tom and his team debut a new sea bass dish and a delicious starter of courgettes and goat's cheese. S1, Ep2

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Secrets Of The Pub Kitchen
programme.desc: Classic Combos. Tom creates classic 'double acts' with two key ingredients. On the menu are fish and chips, steak and ale pie and bread and butter pudding. S1, Ep3

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Secrets Of The Pub Kitchen
programme.desc: Looking Good. Tom and his pub chefs craft dishes that look as stunning as they taste. He shares the secrets behind his signature starter dish, duck liver parfait. S1, Ep4
